//: Development-only reverse proxy for `ng serve`. It is the local stand-in for nginx.conf.
//1: WHY IT EXISTS. Without it the bundle calls http://localhost:6702 directly, so IAM sees
//2: Host: localhost - the PLATFORM host, where only the SuperAdmin account is visible. An
//3: organisation user then fails sign-in with 'The sign-in details are incorrect.' even though
//4: the password is right. Proxying keeps every call same-origin, so a browser on
//5: ten1.localhost:6701 reaches the API as ten1.localhost and the Organisation resolves.
//6: changeOrigin is deliberately left off (false): that is what preserves the tenant Host.
//7: The three rewrites mirror the location blocks in nginx.conf exactly.
